summary: Completed regression testing after the mobile hire-panel CSS change. Backend APIs passed 17/17; live mobile provider hiring and resource rental completed mocked payment flows; desktop sidebar navigation remained intact; frontend production build succeeded with one existing ESLint warning.
action_items: Optionally resolve the React Hook exhaustive-deps warning in Explore (App.js line 26); it did not block compilation or tested flows.
critical_code_review_comments: The mobile stylesheet still uses a broad aside{display:none} rule and relies on a later .hire-panel display override; narrowing the selector to the navigation sidebar would be more robust, although the tested hire flow now works.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created by this iteration; process-local mocked payment state was generated during UI/API tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Requested mobile provider hire, mobile resource rental, desktop sidebar navigation, mocked OTP/payment, and final build were verified. OTP, UPI/contact reveal, and verification upload remain MOCKED by design.
rca of the issue: Iteration 3's mobile failure came from @media(max-width:800px) hiding every aside, including ProviderDetail's hire panel. The added .hire-panel display override preserves the panel and the live mobile hire/payment flow now reaches Requests successfully.
